- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast peak by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.4) — add 1–3% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — cap forecast overshoot at +3% above 30-day moving average.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day high, adjust downward by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment rises sharply 2–3 days before forecast, reduce forecast by 1–2% to account for delayed market reaction.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, avoid assuming linear continuation — cap forecast at 10% above 30-day high if sentiment is strong and price is trending up.
